# W3C ontology fixtures

`wine.rdf` and `food.rdf` are unchanged files downloaded from the W3C OWL Web Ontology Language Guide, Recommendation 10 February 2004. The source URLs, SHA-256 hashes and byte lengths are recorded in `manifest.json`.

Copyright 2004 W3C (MIT, ERCIM, Keio), All Rights Reserved. The guide's [document use](https://www.w3.org/Consortium/Legal/2002/copyright-documents-20021231) and [software licensing](https://www.w3.org/Consortium/Legal/copyright-software) notices apply. The original comments describe derivation from the Stanford DAML Wine ontology and remain in the retained files.

Tests create separate execution copies with local import resolution and explicitly labeled negative-control mutations. These are ontology integration fixtures, not benchmark questions or task-result evidence. See `docs/ontology-semantics.md` for the exact transformation and validation scope.
